data.one_liner: Utilities to help build Dart command-line apps, find the SDK, and display progress.
data.what_it_does: Provides helper functions to locate the Dart SDK and executable directories, manage application configuration directories, and output rich text and progress spinners to the CLI.
use_when: You are building a command-line application in Dart
You need to locate the Dart SDK or application settings path from code
You want to display standard or verbose logging and progress indicators in the terminal
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI or mobile application
You do not need command-line specific utilities or logging
strengths: Simplifies locating the Dart SDK across various execution contexts
Built-in logging mechanisms supporting standard and verbose modes
Includes progress indicators and spinners for long-running tasks
weaknesses: Limited applicability outside of command-line tools

alternatives.name: args
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need command-line argument and option parsing.

alternatives.name: io
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need core Dart I/O utilities rather than CLI-specific helpers.
